The '''warding sword''' is an [[Iron equipment|iron sword]] with a [[Nazar]] set into it. It carries {{G|Warding}} 1, so while held it slows nearby undead and burns the closest one.

== Obtaining ==
=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}
Unlike the [[Silver Sword]] and [[Warding Shield]], the warding sword needs no smithing template, only an iron sword and a nazar. Enchantments already on the iron sword are kept: the sword's warding is stored on the result and merged with the old enchantments once it enters the inventory (see [[Set bonus#Intrinsic enchantments|intrinsic enchantments]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/warding_sword.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Weapon ===
The warding sword deals {{Hp|5}} of damage with an attack speed of 1.6 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/warding_sword.json}}</ref>

=== Warding ===
Held in either hand, the sword gives {{G|Warding}} 1: every second it gives undead within 8 blocks Slowness II and deals {{Hp|1}} of armor-ignoring damage to the nearest one within 3 blocks. It never damages the [[Wither]] on its own.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/warding/power_1.mcfunction}}</ref> Its warding adds to the warding of the item in the other hand, up to {{G|Warding}} 3: with a [[Nazar]] or a second {{G|Warding}} 2 item in the off hand the player has {{G|Warding}} 3, and with a [[Warding Shield]] {{G|Warding}} 2. See [[Warding]].

Because warding is exclusive with other weapon intrinsics, a warding sword can't also carry a [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] or [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] weapon intrinsic.

=== Repairing ===
The warding sword can only be repaired with a [[Nazar]] or a {{MCW|Block of Lapis Lazuli|block of lapis lazuli}}.

== Advancements ==
Smithing the warding sword grants ''Fae-Slayer'' ("Affix a Nazar to an Iron Sword in a Smithing Table") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab. It follows ''Apotropaic Jewellery'' and leads to ''Sabbatarian''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/smith_warding_sword.json}}</ref>
